simple.meaning: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell , etc.)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׁמַע (H8085) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 1165 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שָׁמַע (shâmaʻ) means to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell , etc.) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 10 11.
